actor: Frontier AI lab's consumer subscription pricing and monetization lead
job: Rebuild the roughly $20 entry tier's packaging so the newest flagship model is no longer bundled at flat rate.
outcome: An announced entry-tier change gating the newest flagship behind a usage credit, metered per-token billing, or a higher-priced plan.
motivation: Unmetered flagship access at roughly $20 loses money against a cheaper comparable rival and a rising open-weight floor.

task.who: Consumer monetization and product pricing team
task.what: Redesign entry-tier packaging and flagship entitlement rules
task.where: Subscription plan roadmap and pricing committee reviews
task.why: Stop subsidizing flagship inference at the entry price
task.how: Usage credit plus metered overage above an included allowance

actor: Frontier lab's inference serving cost and gross-margin analytics team
job: Attribute flagship serving cost per subscriber and show the heavy-user tail on the entry tier runs below gross margin.
outcome: A cost-per-subscriber model showing flat-rate flagship access at the entry price is unrecoverable, forcing a repricing decision.
motivation: This is a margin problem rather than a capacity problem, so added serving capacity cannot close it — only pricing can.

task.who: Serving infrastructure economics and finance analytics
task.what: Model per-subscriber flagship token cost and margin tail
task.where: Internal cost telemetry and recurring margin reviews
task.why: Give pricing leadership evidence the entry tier is unrecoverable
task.how: Per-model token accounting joined to subscriber cohort billing data

actor: Frontier lab's consumer billing and entitlements platform engineering team
job: Ship consumer billing plumbing for per-model entitlements, prepaid usage credits, metered overage and tightened weekly usage limits.
outcome: A billing stack that meters flagship use per subscriber and bills beyond an included credit at published token rates.
motivation: Gating a flagship off a flat-rate plan is impossible until credits, metering and quota enforcement exist in consumer billing.

task.who: Billing platform and subscription entitlement engineers
task.what: Build per-model credit balances and overage metering
task.where: Consumer billing service and account entitlement layer
task.why: Make credit-then-meter gating enforceable at consumer subscriber scale
task.how: Usage-credit ledger with per-model rate limits and overage rating

actor: Frontier lab's model-lineup and plan-tier segmentation product manager
job: Map models to plans so the newest flagship becomes a premium metered offering while a cheaper model stays the entry default.
outcome: A published model-to-plan matrix in which the entry tier's flat-rate default is no longer the newest flagship model.
motivation: A cheaper near-frontier default lets the lab withdraw flagship inclusion without pushing entry subscribers to a rival.

task.who: Model product management and plan packaging
task.what: Assign flagship to premium tiers, cheaper model to entry
task.where: Model release planning and plan comparison pages
task.why: Preserve entry-tier value while removing flagship flat-rate access
task.how: Cheaper distilled model positioned as the included default
